coder_notes: Pediatric/young adult (age 4 to 26) recurrent high-grade glioma; includes ependymoma and oligodendroglioma. GBM inclusion rests on 'Grade IV Astrocytoma' in the conditions (historical GBM name). Nivolumab coded as the only non-excluded investigational agent (exHSC is a cell therapy), following the pembrolizumab + vaccine worked example; exHSC treated as the combination partner for regimen. Both arms differ only in timing relative to surgery (adjuvant vs neoadjuvant); no control arm.
